title: Atlas: Backfill and realtime
description: How far the backfill has come, per group and overall, and whether live indexing and processing keep up. Article numbers count the gaps on the server too. Backfill goes newest month first, in day chunks for split groups.

panels.title: Done
panels.description: Article numbers indexed, out of every number between each group's first and last on its server.

panels.title: Shrinking by
panels.description: Articles a hour, net of new posts, over the last 6 hours.

panels.title: ETA
panels.description: Articles left at the last 6 hours' pace. No data means what is left is not shrinking.

panels.title: Day chunks done
panels.description: Split groups backfill a day at a time; this is the share of those days done.

panels.title: Day chunks ETA
panels.description: Days left at the last hour's pace.

panels.title: How far back, middle group
panels.description: How old the oldest indexed post is in the middle group. Climbing means backfill is reaching further back.

panels.title: Per group
panels.description: Article numbers from each group's furthest-along server. Split groups count their day chunks done as that share. ETA at the last 6 hours' pace, blank when not shrinking.

panels.title: Articles behind
panels.description: New articles on the servers that the live cursors have not reached, as of each group's last pass.

panels.title: Groups not moved in 30 min
panels.description: Groups whose live cursor has not moved in 30 minutes, from the database, so a restart does not hide them. Quiet groups land here too: nothing new to index looks the same as not indexing.

panels.title: Newest post, middle group
panels.description: Age of the newest indexed post in the middle group: the lag behind Usenet in time.

panels.title: Articles behind, the 8 furthest behind groups
Newest post indexed, age, the 8 oldest
Headers fetched, not saved
panels.description: Fetching pauses at the cap.

panels.title: Processing stage queue
panels.description: Bounded counts: a big queue reads as its cap.

panels.title: Claims running
panels.description: Net claims running over every shard, out of net_claims_per_shard each.

panels.title: Net visits a minute, per shard
panels.description: Releases the net lane ran a step of.

panels.title: Finished by the net lane a minute, per shard
panels.description: Releases the net lane left with no net step to run.

panels.title: Queue rows taken a minute, per shard
panels.description: The database lane.

panels.title: Queued to freeze
panels.description: Releases the freezing rules queued to move out of the shards. Counted every 5 minutes.

panels.title: Ready to move
panels.description: Of those, the ones queued longer than wait_hours (12 by default), which the writers move now.

panels.title: Longest queued
panels.description: Moves start once this passes wait_hours. A visit to a release queues it afresh.

panels.title: Outbox waiting
panels.description: Changes waiting in the shards' outboxes for the publisher to send to Postgres.

panels.title: Oldest waiting
panels.description: How long the oldest waiting change has waited, over every shard.

panels.title: Sent a minute
panels.description: Rows the publisher wrote to Postgres (upsert) or took out of it (delete).

panels.title: Step errors and panics, by step
